# Manual NC

Type id `manual_nc` · category: Utility · runs in Setups of kind: three_axis, indexed

Inserts one line or block into the program at its place in the Setup: a stop, an optional stop, a comment, a dwell, or text of your own. It cuts nothing.

- Takes the material it cuts out of the stock for the toolpaths after it: no.

See [Add a toolpath](Add-a-Toolpath) for how to add one, and the [list of toolpath types](Toolpath-Types).

In the project file a setting is written as `group.key`, for example `passes.stepover`. In the app the inspector shows each group on its own tab. Lengths are in millimetres in the file whatever unit the project shows.

## Passes

| Setting | File key | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kind | `passes.kind` | `stop`, `optional_stop`, `comment`, `dwell`, `pass_through` | `optional_stop` | What to insert in the program: a `stop`, an `optional_stop`, a `comment`, a `dwell`, or `pass_through` text written as it is. |
| Text | `passes.text` | text | not set | The text for a comment or pass-through. `pass_through` text is written unchecked: you are responsible for it. Allowed: non-empty for `comment`, `pass_through`. Depends on: `kind`. |
| Dwell s | `passes.dwell_s` | seconds | 1 | Seconds to wait at the bottom of the hole, or for a dwell. Allowed: > 0. Depends on: `kind` = `dwell`. |
